thread:
liz: All right team — "Mosaic Interop: Marketplace + HW" webinar locked for May 14 @ 11:00am PT. Need speakers, assets, accessibility interpreter, and pallet plan by EOD Friday.
jamal: I'll collect speaker roster. Names + pronouns + titles to me by Thu noon.
kai: AV has 11:00am PT. We'll simulcast and record. Please supply a 2-min emergency tape and a 30s silent-slide video with captions for accessibility.
maria: Marketing: 200x200 headshot, 1-line bio, 2 talking points, SVG logo, and approved CTA copy (max 60 chars) by Fri. Also need short landing URL for the tweet thread.
sam_cloudleap: CloudLeap confirms Samir + Anya. We'll provide caption copy and a one-line pricing blurb for the marketplace tile.
jun_pixel: PixelCompute will demo hardware perf + graceful degradation. We'll upload a 60s perf clip, 30s fallback clip, and an overlay image for the failover banner.
oliver: Customs/logistics: EU cutoff May 1, domestic May 7. Consolidated SF pallet pickup May 6. For EU shipments include HS code and partner VAT ID on the packing list.
jamal: Redwood allocation: 150 US / 40 EU / 30 APAC. For APAC we recommend QR-only redemption to avoid customs and reduce carbon footprint.
maria: QR-only OK for APAC. US/EU packs = stickers + promo decal + postcard + one partner insert (limited to 100 words). Anna from Legal please confirm co-branded insert text policy.
anna_legal: Quick glance: co-branded messaging must include approved trademark lines. Send draft inserts to legal@redwood for a 48-hour review window.
liz: Run-of-show (tight):
```
10:45 - final tech check
11:00 - host intro 2m
11:02 - CloudLeap keynote 9m
11:11 - PixelCompute clip + live failover 9m
11:20 - Redwood product deep dive 8m
11:28 - Panel Q&A + shared live demo 18m
11:46 - CTA + marketplace tile reveal (show pricing toggle) 6m
11:52 - Close + partner follow-up instructions 3m
```
kai: Please allow a 90s slide swap buffer between live segments. We'll run captions via VTT stream; partners, upload VTT or transcript 24h prior.
maria: Scheduling: dry run May 12 9:00-9:45am PT (includes interpreter check). Pre-show tech check May 14 10:30am PT.
jamie: I'll moderate. Drafting 6 prep Qs and panel order; will share by Thu morning. Also proposing a live poll at Q&A to capture top use-cases.
sam_cloudleap: Request: during CTA can we toggle the marketplace card to show region-specific capacity and a 30-day trial promo code? We'll send the trial code and legal OK tonight.
jun_pixel: For on-stage ops: if GPU node fails, auto-switch to quantized CPU path and display the overlay. We'll provide the overlay PNG and short alt text for screen readers.
oliver: Fulfillment note: label packages "Mosaic Interop / Redwood" and include partner contact. For international, attach commercial invoice with HS code and VAT. Send addresses to fulfillment@redwood-internal.com by Tue.
deploy-bot: Event page drafted at https://dashboard.redwood/events/mosaic-interop-2 — add speaker metadata and marketplace slug.
maria: I'll run a live tweet thread at CTA and post an edited replay 2h after event. Need final blurb + shortened landing URL by Fri noon.
jamal: Collecting headshots & bios Thu morning. Will confirm speaker pronunciation and preferred pronouns in the sheet.
anna_legal: Co-brand legal: we'll need partner logo usage agreement scanned; partners, please send signed logo use form by Thu EOD.
liz: OK team — single source of truth. Drop all assets (headshots, VTT/transcripts, clips, overlay PNGs, insert copy, legal forms) into the shared folder https://drive.redwood/webinars/mosaic-interop by EOD Fri. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
